course.title: Weight Loss and Nutrition
course.tagline: Lose weight safely with food, habits and workouts that actually stick.

days.title: Start here: how weight loss works
days.goal: Learn the simple idea behind losing weight safely.

video.title: weightloss is stupid easy (for beginners)

steps: Watch the video and write down the main idea in one sentence.
Learn this: to lose weight, you use a little more energy than you eat.
Write down your starting weight and waist size today.
Set one small goal: lose half a kilo a week, not more.
days.task: Write your starting numbers and your goal on one page.
days.challenge: Explain weight loss to a friend in one sentence.

quiz.q: How does weight loss work?
options: You use a little more energy than you eat
quiz.explain: A small gap between energy in and energy out leads to slow loss.

quiz.q: How fast should you lose weight?
options: About half a kilo a week
quiz.explain: Slow loss is safe and lasts longer.

quiz.q: What should you write down first?
options: Your starting weight and waist size
quiz.explain: Starting numbers let you see progress.

days.title: Know your food: protein, carbs, fats
days.goal: Learn the 3 main food groups in plain words.

video.title: Complete Guide On Weight Loss

steps: Protein builds and repairs muscle. List 3 protein foods.
Carbs give energy. List 3 carb foods.
Fats protect the body. List 2 healthy fat foods.
Write one meal that has all three groups.
days.task: Write one meal with protein, carbs and healthy fats.
days.challenge: Name 3 protein foods you can buy at a local market.

quiz.q: What does protein do?
quiz.explain: Protein is the building material for muscle.

quiz.q: What do carbs do?
quiz.explain: Carbs are the body's main fuel.

quiz.q: What is a healthy fat food?
quiz.explain: Avocado, nuts and olive oil are healthy fats.

days.title: Build a healthy plate
days.goal: Learn the simple plate rule for every meal.

video.title: How to Create a Healthy Plate [From a Dietitian]

steps: Draw a plate: half vegetables, a quarter protein, a quarter carbs.
Make one meal using the plate rule.
Take a photo of your plate.
Write down how full you felt after eating it.
days.task: Make one meal using the plate rule.
days.challenge: Use the plate rule for all meals tomorrow.

quiz.q: What goes on half the plate?
quiz.explain: Half the plate is vegetables.

quiz.q: What goes on a quarter of the plate?
options: Protein, like beans, fish or eggs
quiz.explain: A quarter of the plate is protein.

quiz.q: Why use the plate rule?
options: It keeps meals balanced without counting
quiz.explain: The plate rule makes balanced eating easy.

days.title: Drink water, skip sugary drinks
days.goal: Learn why water helps weight loss and sugary drinks hurt it.

video.title: How to Start Your Weight Loss Journey | Beginner's Guide

steps: Count how many sugary drinks you had yesterday.
Drink a glass of water before each meal today.
Carry a water bottle with you all day.
Write down how many glasses of water you drank.
days.task: Drink 6 to 8 glasses of water today.
days.challenge: Go a full day with no sugary drinks.

quiz.q: Why drink water before a meal?
options: It helps you feel full and eat a little less
quiz.explain: Water before meals helps you eat less.

quiz.q: What is wrong with sugary drinks?
options: They add lots of calories with no fullness
quiz.explain: Sugary drinks add calories without filling you up.

quiz.q: How much water should you aim for?
quiz.explain: Six to eight glasses is a good daily aim.

days.title: Walk every day
days.goal: Start a daily walking habit that burns energy gently.

video.title: Beginner 1 Mile Walk

steps: Walk for 10 minutes after one meal today.
Count your steps with your phone if you can.
Walk a little further each day this week.
Write down your steps and how you felt.
days.task: Walk 10 minutes after lunch today.
days.challenge: Walk 30 minutes in total today.

quiz.q: Why walk after a meal?
options: It helps digestion and burns a little energy
quiz.explain: A short walk after eating helps your body use the food.

quiz.q: How much walking should you aim for?
quiz.explain: Thirty minutes a day is a good aim.

quiz.q: What should you do if you feel tired while walking?
quiz.explain: Slowing down keeps walking safe.

days.title: Sleep helps weight loss
days.goal: Learn why good sleep makes weight loss easier.

video.title: If I Wanted to Lose My Gut FAST

steps: Sleep 7 to 8 hours tonight.
Go to bed at the same time as last night.
Keep your phone away from your bed.
Write down how hungry you felt today.
days.task: Sleep 7 to 8 hours tonight.
days.challenge: Go to bed and wake up at the same time for 3 days.

quiz.q: Why does sleep help weight loss?
options: Poor sleep makes you hungrier the next day
quiz.explain: Good sleep keeps hunger hormones in balance.

quiz.q: How much sleep should you aim for?
quiz.explain: Seven to eight hours is the healthy aim.

quiz.q: What should you do before bed?
options: Put your phone away and wind down
quiz.explain: Winding down helps you fall asleep.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 1: Your food diary
days.goal: Put week 1 together: keep a simple food diary for 3 days.

video.title: Meal Planning For Beginners (in 6 easy steps)

steps: Write down everything you eat and drink for 3 days.
Note the time and how hungry you felt.
Circle one thing you can improve, like sugary drinks.
Write one small change you will make next week.
days.task: Keep a food diary for 3 days.
days.challenge: Find one pattern in your diary and write it down.

quiz.q: What is a food diary?
options: A written list of what you eat and drink
quiz.explain: A food diary shows what you really eat.

quiz.q: Why keep a food diary?
options: It shows patterns you can improve
quiz.explain: Seeing your real eating helps you change one thing.

quiz.q: What should you do with your diary?
options: Pick one small thing to improve
quiz.explain: One small change at a time works best.

project.title: Your food diary
project.brief: Keep a simple food diary for 3 days: write everything you eat and drink, note hunger, and pick one small thing to improve.
checks: Every meal and drink is written

days.title: Move more in daily life
days.goal: Burn more energy with small daily moves.

video.title: Keep Your Diet Simple: A Doctor's Approach to Eating Healthy

steps: Take the stairs instead of the lift once today.
Stand up and stretch every hour.
Walk to a nearby shop instead of driving.
Write down 3 small moves you did today.
days.task: Do 3 small active things today.
days.challenge: Take the stairs 3 times today.

quiz.q: Why do small moves help?
options: They add up and burn energy through the day
quiz.explain: Small moves through the day add up.

quiz.q: What is a good small move?
quiz.explain: Stairs are an easy daily exercise.

quiz.q: How often should you stand up?
quiz.explain: Standing once an hour breaks up long sitting.

days.title: Plan your meals for the week
days.goal: Learn to plan meals so you eat well without stress.

video.title: How to Meal Prep a Week of Food in 1 HOUR!

steps: Pick 3 healthy dinners for this week.
Write a shopping list for those meals.
Shop once and buy only what is on the list.
Cook one meal and save the rest for tomorrow.
days.task: Write a 3-day meal plan and a shopping list.
days.challenge: Cook one planned meal tonight.

quiz.q: Why plan meals?
quiz.explain: A plan makes healthy eating easy.

quiz.q: Why write a shopping list?
options: So you buy only what you need
quiz.explain: A list stops impulse buying.

quiz.q: What should you do with leftovers?
quiz.explain: Leftovers save time and money.

days.title: Eat slowly and notice fullness
days.goal: Learn to eat slowly so you notice when you are full.

video.title: How to make a meal plan on a budget

steps: Put your fork down between bites.
Chew each bite 10 times.
Stop eating when you feel 80 percent full.
Write down how it felt to eat slowly.
days.task: Eat one meal slowly today, putting your fork down between bites.
days.challenge: Eat without your phone or TV for one meal.

quiz.q: Why eat slowly?
options: It gives your body time to feel full
quiz.explain: Slow eating helps you stop before overeating.

quiz.q: When should you stop eating?
options: When you feel about 80 percent full
quiz.explain: Stopping at 80 percent full avoids overeating.

quiz.q: Why put your phone away while eating?
options: So you notice your food and fullness
It is a rule with no reason
quiz.explain: Eating without screens helps you notice fullness.

days.title: Healthy snacks that fill you up
days.goal: Learn snacks that keep you full without many calories.

video.title: Healthy Meal Planning Video

steps: List 3 filling snacks: fruit, nuts, yoghurt, boiled eggs.
Prepare one snack in advance for tomorrow.
Eat your snack slowly and notice if you feel full.
Write down which snack kept you full longest.
days.task: Prepare a healthy snack for tomorrow.
days.challenge: Swap one sugary snack for fruit this week.

quiz.q: What makes a good snack?
options: Protein or fibre that keeps you full
quiz.explain: Protein and fibre snacks keep hunger away.

quiz.q: Why prepare snacks in advance?
options: So you grab something healthy, not junk
quiz.explain: Ready snacks stop rushed bad choices.

quiz.q: What is a filling snack?
options: A boiled egg or a handful of nuts
quiz.explain: Eggs and nuts keep you full for hours.

days.title: Cook at home more often
days.goal: Learn why home cooking helps weight loss.

video.title: weightloss is stupid easy (for beginners)

steps: Cook one meal at home today.
Use less oil: one spoon, not a flood.
Add vegetables to the meal.
Write down what you cooked and how it tasted.
days.task: Cook one healthy meal at home today.
days.challenge: Cook at home 3 times this week.

quiz.q: Why cook at home?
options: You control the oil, salt and portions
quiz.explain: Home cooking lets you control what goes in.

quiz.q: How much oil should you use?
quiz.explain: One spoon of oil is enough for most meals.

quiz.q: Why add vegetables to a meal?
options: They fill you up with few calories
quiz.explain: Vegetables add bulk and nutrients cheaply.

days.title: Handle cravings simply
days.goal: Learn what to do when you crave sweet or salty food.

video.title: Complete Guide On Weight Loss

steps: When a craving comes, wait 10 minutes and drink water.
Ask yourself: am I hungry or just bored?
If you are hungry, eat a healthy snack.
Write down one craving and what you did.
days.task: Use the 10-minute wait trick once today.
days.challenge: Write down 2 cravings and what you did about them.

quiz.q: What is a craving?
options: A strong want for a certain food
quiz.explain: A craving is a strong want, not always real hunger.

quiz.q: What should you do when a craving comes?
quiz.explain: Waiting helps you see if you are truly hungry.

quiz.q: How do you tell hunger from boredom?
options: Ask: would I eat a plain meal right now?
quiz.explain: If a plain meal sounds good, you are truly hungry.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 2: Your weekly meal plan
days.goal: Put week 2 together: write a full week of healthy meals.

video.title: MEAL PLANNING for Beginners | 6 Easy Steps

steps: Plan 7 dinners using the plate rule.
Write a shopping list for the week.
Cook at least 3 of the meals.
Write down what worked and what was hard.
days.task: Write your 7-day meal plan.
days.challenge: Cook 3 planned meals this week.

quiz.q: What should a weekly plan include?
quiz.explain: A full week plan makes eating easy.

quiz.q: Why shop once for the week?
options: It saves time and stops impulse buying
quiz.explain: One shop a week keeps you on plan.

quiz.q: What should you do if a meal is hard to cook?
options: Swap it for a simpler one
quiz.explain: A simpler swap keeps the plan going.

project.title: Your weekly meal plan
project.brief: Write a full week of dinners using the plate rule, with a shopping list, and cook at least 3 of the meals.
checks: Every meal uses the plate rule
Used the plate rule while cooking
Wrote what worked and what was hard

days.title: Move more: add strength
days.goal: Add simple strength moves to help weight loss.

video.title: How to Start Your Weight Loss Journey | Beginner's Guide

steps: Do 10 squats and 5 wall push-ups.
Rest 1 minute and repeat once.
Do this 3 times this week.
Write down how you felt after.
days.task: Do 2 rounds of squats and push-ups today.
days.challenge: Do the strength moves 3 times this week.

quiz.q: Why does strength help weight loss?
options: Muscle burns more energy, even at rest
quiz.explain: More muscle means your body uses more energy.

quiz.q: How often should a beginner do strength moves?
quiz.explain: Three times a week builds muscle safely.

quiz.q: What is a good beginner strength move?
quiz.explain: Bodyweight squats are safe and simple.

days.title: Read food labels simply
days.goal: Learn to read a food label in 30 seconds.

video.title: How To Read Nutrition Labels For Healthier Eating | Nutritionist Explains

steps: Look at the serving size first.
Check sugar: less than 5 grams per 100 grams is low.
Check salt: less than 0.3 grams per 100 grams is low.
Compare two similar foods and pick the better one.
days.task: Compare two foods in your kitchen by their labels.
days.challenge: Pick the lower-sugar option next time you shop.

quiz.q: What should you check first on a label?
quiz.explain: Serving size tells you what the numbers mean.

quiz.q: What is a low sugar level?
quiz.explain: Under 5 grams per 100 grams is low sugar.

quiz.q: Why compare two foods?
quiz.explain: Comparing helps you choose better.

days.title: Eat out without ruining progress
days.goal: Learn simple choices when you eat at a restaurant.

video.title: If I Wanted to Lose My Gut FAST

steps: Pick grilled food instead of fried.
Ask for sauce on the side.
Drink water instead of a sugary drink.
Stop eating when you feel full, even if food is left.
days.task: Use one eat-out tip at your next meal out.
days.challenge: Share a large meal with a friend.

quiz.q: What is a better choice at a restaurant?
quiz.explain: Grilled food has less fat than fried.

quiz.q: Why ask for sauce on the side?
options: So you control how much you use
quiz.explain: Sauce on the side lets you use a little.

quiz.q: What should you do with leftover food?
options: Stop when full and take it home
quiz.explain: Stopping when full is the healthy choice.

days.title: Keep going when progress slows
days.goal: Learn what to do when weight loss pauses.

video.title: Meal Planning For Beginners (in 6 easy steps)

steps: Check your food diary for hidden extras.
Add one more walk this week.
Drink water before each meal.
Remember: a pause is normal, not failure.
days.task: Add one extra walk this week.
days.challenge: Write down 3 things you have done well so far.

quiz.q: Why does weight loss pause sometimes?
options: The body adjusts and needs a small change
quiz.explain: Pauses are normal; a small change restarts progress.

quiz.q: What is a good first fix for a pause?
options: Add one more walk and check your diary
quiz.explain: One small change is safe and works.

quiz.q: What should you remember during a pause?
options: A pause is normal, not failure
quiz.explain: Pauses happen to everyone; keep going.

days.title: Build your support team
days.goal: Learn how friends and family help weight loss.

video.title: Keep Your Diet Simple: A Doctor's Approach to Eating Healthy

steps: Tell one person about your goal.
Ask a friend to walk with you once a week.
Cook a healthy meal with a family member.
Write down who supports you.
days.task: Tell one person your goal today.
days.challenge: Walk with a friend this week.

quiz.q: Why tell someone your goal?
options: Support keeps you going when it gets hard
quiz.explain: Sharing your goal brings help and cheer.

quiz.q: What can a friend do to help?
options: Walk with you and cheer you on
quiz.explain: A walking friend makes it fun and steady.

quiz.q: What should you do if someone offers you junk food?
options: Say no kindly and offer a healthy swap
quiz.explain: A kind no keeps your plan on track.

days.title: Plan for parties and holidays
days.goal: Learn to enjoy events without losing progress.

video.title: How to Meal Prep a Week of Food in 1 HOUR!

steps: Eat a healthy snack before the party.
Fill half your plate with vegetables first.
Drink water between any other drinks.
Enjoy one treat, then stop.
days.task: Use the party plan at your next event.
days.challenge: Eat a healthy snack before your next outing.

quiz.q: Why eat before a party?
options: So you are not starving when you arrive
quiz.explain: A snack before stops overeating at the party.

quiz.q: What should you fill your plate with first?
quiz.explain: Vegetables first fill you up with few calories.

quiz.q: How many treats should you enjoy?
quiz.explain: One treat lets you enjoy without overdoing it.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 3: Your full healthy week
days.goal: Put week 3 together: live one full healthy week.

video.title: How to make a meal plan on a budget

steps: Follow your meal plan for 7 days.
Walk 30 minutes every day.
Sleep 7 to 8 hours each night.
Write down what was easy and what was hard.
days.task: Live your healthy week and record each day.
days.challenge: Tick off every healthy day on your calendar.

quiz.q: What should a healthy week include?
options: Planned meals, daily walks and good sleep
quiz.explain: Food, movement and sleep work together.

quiz.q: Why record each day?
options: So you can see what worked
quiz.explain: Records show your wins and your hard spots.

quiz.q: What should you do after the week?
options: Keep what worked and fix what was hard
quiz.explain: Keep the wins and fix the hard parts.

project.title: Your full healthy week
project.brief: Live one full healthy week: follow your meal plan, walk 30 minutes daily, sleep 7 to 8 hours, and record each day.
checks: Followed the meal plan for 7 days

days.title: Check your progress
days.goal: Measure your progress the right way.

video.title: Healthy Meal Planning Video

steps: Weigh yourself at the same time of day.
Measure your waist with a tape.
Compare with your starting numbers.
Write down what improved.
days.task: Record your weight and waist today.
days.challenge: Compare with your day 1 numbers.

quiz.q: When should you weigh yourself?
options: At the same time of day each time
quiz.explain: Same time gives true comparisons.

quiz.q: What else should you measure besides weight?
quiz.explain: Waist size shows fat loss even when weight pauses.

quiz.q: How often should you weigh yourself?
quiz.explain: Once a week shows the trend without stress.

days.title: Make it last: habits for life
days.goal: Learn how to keep your new habits for good.

video.title: weightloss is stupid easy (for beginners)

steps: Pick 3 habits you want to keep forever.
Write each habit on a card and put it where you see it.
Plan what to do when life gets busy.
Celebrate how far you have come.
days.task: Write your 3 forever habits on cards.
days.challenge: Celebrate your progress today.

quiz.q: What makes a habit last?
quiz.explain: Small and often builds habits that stick.

quiz.q: What should you do when life gets busy?
options: Keep a tiny version of the habit
quiz.explain: A tiny version keeps the habit alive.

quiz.q: Why celebrate progress?
options: It reminds you how far you have come
quiz.explain: Celebrating keeps you going.

days.title: Cook a healthy feast
days.goal: Cook a full healthy meal for yourself or family.

video.title: Complete Guide On Weight Loss

steps: Pick a protein, a carb and two vegetables.
Cook using the plate rule.
Use one spoon of oil and less salt.
Share the meal and enjoy it slowly.
days.task: Cook a healthy feast today.
days.challenge: Teach a family member the plate rule.

quiz.q: What should a healthy feast have?
quiz.explain: A feast with all food groups is balanced.

quiz.q: How much oil should you use?
quiz.explain: One spoon is enough for most meals.

quiz.q: Why share a healthy meal?
options: It helps your family eat well too
quiz.explain: Sharing spreads healthy habits.

days.title: Plan your next month
days.goal: Make a plan to keep losing weight safely next month.

video.title: Achieving sustainable weight loss: top 3 tips from a dietitian

steps: Set a goal for next month: half a kilo a week.
Pick 3 meals you will cook every week.
Pick 3 days to walk and 3 days for strength.
Write the plan on one page.
days.task: Write your next-month plan.
days.challenge: Put your plan where you can see it.

quiz.q: What is a safe monthly goal?
quiz.explain: Two kilos a month is safe and steady.

quiz.q: What should your plan include?
quiz.explain: Food and movement together work best.

quiz.q: Why write the plan down?
options: So you can see it and follow it
quiz.explain: A written plan is easy to follow.

days.title: Handle stress without food
days.goal: Learn ways to calm stress that do not use food.

video.title: How to Start Your Weight Loss Journey | Beginner's Guide

steps: When stressed, take 5 slow breaths.
Go for a 10-minute walk.
Call a friend and talk.
Write down what stressed you and what helped.
days.task: Use one stress trick today instead of snacking.
days.challenge: Write down 3 stress tricks that work for you.

quiz.q: Why do people eat when stressed?
options: Food feels like comfort in the moment
quiz.explain: Stress eating is a habit, not real hunger.

quiz.q: What is a good stress trick?
quiz.explain: A walk or breathing calms the body.

quiz.q: What should you do after a stressful day?
options: Rest, breathe and talk to someone
quiz.explain: Rest and talk help more than food.

days.title: Your healthy shopping list
days.goal: Learn to shop for a healthy week in one trip.

video.title: GROCERY SHOPPING FOR WEIGHT LOSS + GROCERY LIST

steps: Plan your meals first, then write the list.
Shop the outside of the shop first: fruit, vegetables and meat.
Pick whole foods you can see and name.
Skip sugary drinks and snacks at the till.
Buy frozen vegetables as a back-up.
Check your list before you pay.
days.task: Write a shopping list for your next week.
days.challenge: Buy only what is on your list.

quiz.q: Why plan meals before shopping?
options: So you buy only what you need
quiz.explain: Planning first stops impulse buying.

quiz.q: Where are the fresh foods in most shops?
quiz.explain: Fresh food usually sits around the edges of the shop.

quiz.q: What is a good back-up food?
quiz.explain: Frozen vegetables are healthy and last for months.

days.title: Get ready for your capstone
days.goal: Review the whole course and prepare your final project.

video.title: If I Wanted to Lose My Gut FAST

steps: Read your notes from weeks 1 to 4.
List 5 things you learned about food and weight.
Practise your capstone meal plan once.
Write down any questions you still have.
days.task: List 5 things you learned in this course.
days.challenge: Cook one capstone meal from memory.

quiz.q: What is the capstone?
options: A final project that shows what you learned
quiz.explain: The capstone is your final show of skill.

quiz.q: What should you review before the capstone?
options: Your notes from all four weeks
quiz.explain: Reviewing all weeks brings the course together.

quiz.q: How do you know you are ready?
options: You can plan a healthy week and cook the meals
quiz.explain: Planning and cooking a healthy week shows you are ready.

days.title: Final practice day
days.goal: Practise your capstone once more, then rest.

video.title: Meal Planning For Beginners (in 6 easy steps)

steps: Cook one capstone meal and time it.
Check your meal plan for the week.
Fix anything that felt hard.
Rest well tonight.
days.task: Cook one capstone meal and time it.
days.challenge: Fix one hard part of your plan.

quiz.q: Why practise once more?
options: Practice makes the real run calm and smooth
quiz.explain: Practice turns worry into calm confidence.

quiz.q: What should you check after practice?
options: Your timing, your portions and your plan
quiz.explain: Checking timing and portions makes the week smooth.

quiz.q: What should you do the night before?
quiz.explain: Good rest helps you do your best.

days.title: Capstone day: your healthy week
days.goal: Show what you learned: present your healthy week plan and cook one meal.

video.title: Keep Your Diet Simple: A Doctor's Approach to Eating Healthy

steps: Show your 7-day meal plan using the plate rule.
Cook one full healthy meal.
Explain your plan in simple words.
Write a short report on your month.
days.task: Present your plan, cook your meal and write your report.
days.challenge: Hand in your report and celebrate.

quiz.q: What should your plan show?
quiz.explain: A full week plan shows real skill.

quiz.q: What should your meal include?
quiz.explain: A balanced meal has all food groups.

quiz.q: What goes in your report?
options: What you did and what you learned
quiz.explain: A short report shows what you learned.

capstone.title: Your healthy week plan
capstone.brief: Present a 7-day healthy meal plan using the plate rule, cook one full balanced meal, explain your plan in simple words, and write a short report on your month.
checks: Every meal uses the plate rule
deliverables: A short video or photos of your meal
